description: This file defines the Response class and related functions for handling and rendering responses in a Playwright-based system, including capturing snapshots, managing results, errors, images, files, and serializing responses with support for markdown and meta information.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Class for constructing, managing, and rendering a response, including results, code, images, files, and snapshots.

classes.name: RenderedResponse
classes.description: Class representing a rendered response with methods to generate text, meta, and handle redaction.

methods.name: renderTabSnapshot
methods.description: Function to render a tab snapshot into the response, including console messages, downloads, and page state.

methods.name: renderTabsMarkdown
methods.description: Function to generate markdown list of open tabs.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Utility to truncate text to a maximum length.

methods.name: parseSections
methods.description: Function to parse markdown sections from response text.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Function to parse a CallToolResult into a structured response object.
